title: Beatable Superflat
description: Access the Nether and the End on Structureless Superflat!
body:
![Banner: BEATABLE SUPERFLAT](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fa462c39c9e6e991a180921a1a1b3729c9076998.png)

## 📖 About

Beatable Superflat lets you actually defeat the Ender Dragon in the **Structureless Superflat Survival challenge**. It adds methods to get essential items that you can’t find in this kind of world, like: **Lava Buckets**, **Blaze Rods**, and **End Portal Frames**. _If you’re wondering how to grab those, check out the “How to Beat” section down below for the details._

## 🌍 Versions

Since this pack enables access to both **the Nether** and **the End** in a superflat world, there are **two versions** available:

- **Version 1 (v1.x)** – Allows access to both the Nether and the End without changing how those dimensions generate. (The End and the Nether stay the same as in a normal vanilla world).
- **Version 2 (v2.x)** – Works the same as Version 1 (in terms of getting to other dimensions), but generates **both the Nether and the End as superflat worlds**. 

_Image below - superflat Nether. (v2.x)_

![Superflat Nether](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/068273d381fa97eadbe930364680a2b49e2cbf89.jpeg)

💡 *Note: **If you aren't playing the Structureless Challenge**, Version 2 can still generate structures if you enable them. This means you’ll still be able to find locations like End Cities and Bastions, even though the dimensions are superflat. In this case, **all the datapack does is make all dimensions superflat**; the custom methods for obtaining End Portal Frames, Lava, or Blaze Rods are simply alternatives to finding them within structures.*

## 🏆 How to Beat the Challenge

To complete **Structureless Superflat Survival**, you need the three items mentioned earlier. Here is how you can obtain them:

- **Lava Bucket** – First, defeat an Illager Raid to gain the **Hero of the Village effect**. While the effect is active, find a **Toolsmith**. As a reward for protecting the village, they may **throw you a Lava Bucket as a gift**.

- **Blaze Rod** – This works the same way as the Lava Bucket. Once you have Hero of the Village, **a Librarian can gift you a Blaze Rod**.

- **End Portal Frame** – These can be obtained through **Piglin bartering**. Each trade has roughly a **1 in 250 chance** of giving you an End Portal Frame, so building a gold farm is highly recommended.

## 📦 Installation

### Datapack
1. Download the datapack file.
2. Place it in your world's `datapacks` folder.
3. Run `/reload` or restart the world.

### Mod
1. Install the required mod loader.
2. Place the `.jar` file into the `mods` folder.
3. Launch the game.

## ⚙️ Compatibility

This pack is designed primarily for the Structureless Superflat Survival challenge.

It is compatible with all vanilla gameplay features; however, other datapacks or mods that modify the following may conflict with it:

- villager gifts (not trading!)
- piglin bartering
- world generation
